narrative.overview: RiqoPDF is a tool marketplace, not a marketing site — but a workbench doesn't have to feel cold. The system stays close to a Linear/Vercel-style neutral foundation but warms it up the way Notion does: rounder corners, a soft resting shadow under every card instead of flat-until-hover, and one confident, deep blue pulled from the RiqoPDF logo as the single brand accent.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome neutral base; color is meaningful, not decorative
Soft ambient shadow at rest on every card (not just on hover)
Rounder corners than a pure Linear aesthetic (12–16px)
One brand accent (deep blue), one reserved semantic accent (green, local only)
System font stack, no display webfont

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Riqo Blue appears on at most one element per view unless that element is a repeated list. It marks the single next action, never decoration.

rules.name: The Green Means Local Rule
rules.body: Local-Signal Green never appears anywhere except the "runs in your browser" badge family.

rules.name: The No-Serif Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system uses a serif or display webfont.

rules.name: The Always-Raised Rule
rules.body: Cards are never perfectly flat against the page background in either theme.

dos: Do keep exactly one brand accent (Riqo Blue) and one reserved semantic accent (green, local-only)
Do give every card a resting shadow (light) or resting border+surface-tone (dark)
Do use 12–16px radii as the default
Do hold every color pair to WCAG 2.1 AA contrast in both themes
donts: Don't use Local-Signal Green for anything except the "processed locally" claim
Don't copy iLovePDF's branding, logo, or layout
Don't rely on color alone to convey state
